name: Lamune 2
source:
A summer tale begins in a rural seaside town. The burning sun, the sounds of the cicadas, pure white beaches and the blue sea and skies as far as the eye can see. One would expect that something will happen, but at the same time it feels like surely nothing will. And so this summer begins just like every one before it.

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2017/01/01/january-2017-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
故事从乡间海滨小镇的夏日开始。炽热的阳光、蝉鸣、纯白沙滩，还有一望无际的蓝色海洋与天空。人们会期待有什么事情发生，同时又觉得今年肯定也什么都不会发生。于是，这个夏天像往年一样开始了。

[来源：[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2017/01/01/january-2017-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
